stem: How does the author organize the excerpt from the article “Millennials. . . So Happy Together”?
instruction: Use “Millennials. . . So Happy Together” to answer the following question.

options.label: A
options.text: The author describes a current business phenomenon and then explains how it hinges on Millennial traits.

options.label: B
options.text: The author explains why co-working and co-living spaces only appeal to Millennials and then describes how companies are involved.

options.label: C
options.text: The author outlines characteristics of the Millennial generation and then demonstrates how Millennials apply them to their work lives.

options.label: D
options.text: The author offers statistics about some of the most successful startups marketed at Millennials and then explains how they succeed.
